protocolMetadata.instructions:
Crustdata's data on people, companies, job postings and LinkedIn posts: employment history, education, skills, headcount, funding and investors, tech stack, work emails and phone numbers. For a named company, identify_company (free) returns the crustdata_company_id that enrich_company, search_jobs, get_company_jobs_live and the company filters of search_people take. The indexed search and enrich tools cost the least per record; the _live tools fetch the same kinds of data fresh, at a higher price.

autocomplete_person_filter, autocomplete_company_filter and autocomplete_job_filter return the exact stored values for a filter field, and list_search_fields lists each index's fields and value formats. The indexed searches return up to `limit` records with total_count and next_cursor; search_jobs and search_social_posts take `limit: 0` for a free count. Each tool description states its credit cost; get_credit_balance and get_plan_access are free. web_search and fetch_web_pages return news and web pages.

tool.name: search_people
tool.title: Search people
tool.description: Returns people from Crustdata's index of 800M+ professional profiles, each with a LinkedIn profile URL, employment history with dates, education and location, that match filters on current or past employer, title, seniority, function, location, school, skills, years of experience or job start date, or a plain-language `search`: decision makers and leaders at a company, employees, alumni, people who previously worked at a company, people who changed jobs since a date, candidates for a role. Returns up to `limit` profiles with total_count and next_cursor; get_person_contact_info returns emails and phone numbers. 0.03 credits per profile returned. Premium field groups (experience, education, skills and others) add a per-profile charge when filtered on or returned; the default fields include the current employer, from the experience group, and `fields` adds full history and education. get_plan_access lists this key's prices. Field paths and value formats: list_search_fields. Stored values for titles, seniority, functions and industries: autocomplete_person_filter. A company filter takes identify_company's crustdata_company_id on experience.employment_details.current.company_id, or a bare domain such as stripe.com on experience.employment_details.current.company_website_domain.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Crustdata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Crustdata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://install.crustdata.com/mcp/tools.
